Give the persona a first and last name that reflects the plausible, genuine name diversity found within any real demographic group, WITHOUT stereotyping: do not mechanically derive the name from the persona's race/ethnicity (e.g. do not always assign a name that 'matches' that group, and do not treat race/ethnicity as a lookup table for names). Do not name specific real companies, real plan names, or real places beyond a generic reference to living in Maricopa County, Arizona.

response.backstory: Mara Whitcomb is a financially comfortable 67-year-old living in Maricopa County, Arizona, who recently became eligible for Medicare after years of employer-sponsored coverage. She pays close attention to her ongoing health needs and wants a Medicare Advantage plan that makes it easy to see a broad range of providers and keeps her care well coordinated. Her day-to-day life includes managing appointments, staying active, and keeping up with family commitments, so dependable access matters more to her than the lowest premium. She is still comparing plans against the convenience and flexibility she was accustomed to through work.
